provenance_note: Observed Claude Code policy rendering/refusal after explicit /circuit-spec-integration invocation with a frozen evidence packet. Deterministic forward fixtures separately prove routing and evidence discovery; these runs do not claim independent model discovery of IDs.

runs.prompt: Deepen the LM2596S-ADJ C347423 U4 negative rail below -13.5 V and prove the effective input voltage, the RVT1H101M0810 C970687 bridge capacitor, a SMAJ20A C571370 clamp event, and inverting startup against the 3 A PD contract all stay safe.

conditions: U4 GND pin rides at the negative output, so effective input is VIN plus output magnitude: 28.53 V nominal, 45.93 V at the conditioned 32.4 V SMAJ20A clamp table point, 0.93 V past the 45 V absolute maximum
C9 bridges +15 V to the -13.5 V rail with 28.5 V of applied stress at nominal, leaving 21.5 V of margin to its 50 V rating
documented inverting startup demand up to ~4.5 A for >=2 ms exceeds the 3.0 A PD contract by 1.5 A; ringing, startup, and clamp waveforms unmeasured
response.refusal: Deepening the negative rail worsens U4 effective input overstress (currently 45.93 V at SMAJ20A 32.4 V clamp table point, exceeding 45 V absolute maximum by 0.93 V) without transient bench evidence; deepening is not authorized.

runs.prompt: Power on the +12 V output rail through the SMD1210P150TF/16 C7529589 polyfuse and certify the L7812CD2T C13456 and CJ7912 C94173 linear regulators deliver their rated output currents from the documented DC-DC intermediate rails.

conditions: PTC1 (decision g replacement, SMD1210P150TF/16 C7529589) 16 VDC maximum on the +12 V rail is +4 V of margin, PASS; PTC2/PTC3 voltage margins also PASS; PTC1's 0.3 A hold margin has no retained 85 C derating row for the /16 variant
L7812 headroom is 0.5 V short of its 2 V typical 1 A dropout and no 1.2 A dropout is specified
CJ7912's -13.5 V input sits 1.0 V outside its -14.5 to -27 V guaranteed band; L7805 margin is typical-only
response.refusal: Cannot certify rated output delivery: rule-ldo-dropout-chain forbids claiming any regulated output at rated load because the L7812CD2T dropout at 1.2 A is unspecified and the CJ7912 operates outside its guaranteed input band, and rule-pptc-vmax-vs-rail forbids treating the +12 V rail as bench-cleared due to unmeasured tripped-state behavior and absence of 85 C hold-current derating for the C7529589 variant.

runs.prompt: Reprogram the STUSB4500QTR C2678061 NVM to accept a 20 V PDO3 and prove the AO3401A C347476 load switch gate network and the SMAJ20A C571370 and SMAJ6.5A C87267 protection chain keep every downstream absolute maximum safe.

conditions: ideal VBEN-low divider gives VGS -9.62 V at 15 V (2.38 V margin) and -12.82 V at 20 V, 0.82 V past the +/-12 V absolute maximum - the deterministic BLOCKER that feeds the 20 V contract decision

SMAJ20A 32.4 V clamp table point sits 4.4 V above the mirror-only 28 V STUSB4500 absolute maxima and 2.4 V past the Q1 -30 V VDS rating with the switch off; the D5 20 V standoff has zero margin at a 20 V contract

TVS2 (decision a replacement, SMAJ6.5A/C87267) standoff clears the +5 V rail by 1.5 V and the L7805 5.2 V upper band by 1.3 V; its 11.2 V clamp table point has no retained downstream +5 V absolute maximum to compare against; SMAJ15A holds 25 percent standoff margin
response.refusal: Cannot authorize any 20 V-capable NVM image while the R11/R12 gate divider arithmetically sets VGS to -12.82 V at the 20 V contract, 0.82 V past the AO3401A absolute maximum; cannot prove the SMAJ20A and SMAJ6.5A protection chain safe while the SMAJ20A clamp at 32.4 V arithmetically exceeds the Q1 -30 V VDS rating by 2.4 V with the load switch off, and the STUSB4500 absolute maxima remain mirror-only without measured installed surge waveforms.
